note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super and two highlight lines, then the end card. The last spoken row is captions only.

mg.title: Hook question

text.main: What do you wish every donor understood?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “What do you wish every donor understood?” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:10 for 3 s, lower left: “Lucinda Patterson” / Chief Financial Officer, CASS
mg.use: Put it on at 00:10 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Chief Financial Officer, CASS> under the name.

mg.title: Clients come first
mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 00:15 for 2 s: “Clients come first.”
mg.use: Put it on as she says it, at 00:15, for 2 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Not frivolously
mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 00:30 for 3 s: “It's not being used frivolously.”
mg.use: Put it on as she says it, about 00:30, for 3 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry). The CASS name is typed in CASS navy until the logo file is added to endcards/cass/. Wording from the client file: cassaz.org.
mg.use: After her last line at 00:54. Hold it to the end. Music fades out over 1 s.
